page_title: Adrafinil — it sleeps when there's nothing left to do

sources.entry: Adrafinil - Keep your Mac awake only while AI agents are still working, then let it sleep normally. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/kageroumado/adrafinil) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Adrafinil
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS tool that keeps your Mac awake with the lid closed only while AI agent sessions (such as Claude Code or Codex) are still working.
keywords: keep laptop running with lid closed
use_cases: keep a Mac awake while an AI coding agent runs a long task
run foreground processes with the lid closed during agent work
let the Mac sleep normally once agents go idle
hold the Mac awake for a timed deploy or build
install hooks for Claude Code or Codex to manage sleep automatically
summary.what_it_does: Adrafinil acquires a sleep hold when an AI agent turn starts and releases it when the agent goes idle, blocking sleep while at least one session holds an assertion. It installs hooks for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and other agents in one click, and counts overlapping sessions so the last release lets the Mac sleep. A command-line interface offers acquire, release and timed hold commands (for example, a 30-minute hold with a reason). The page also lists extras such as locking the screen on lid close, a chime when the hold engages, a morning summary of session duration and temperature, and releasing holds when the Mac gets too hot.
notable: Holds sleep only while AI agent sessions are active, then releases so the Mac can sleep normally
One-click hook installation for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and other agents, with full uninstall
Command-line interface: acquire, release and timed hold commands
Runs policy without root; helper uses pmset disablesleep and resets on restart
caveats: Helper uses pmset disablesleep, which also blocks idle sleep; it resets when the helper restarts, and manual restore requires sudo pmset -a disablesleep 0
Optional anonymous daily check-in telemetry, only if the user opts in
